rows.en: Good work.
Glad we both made it.
Well, glad the mission ended safely, I say.
Was my support helpful?
Looks like we were both in good form.
Looks like my soul got through to you, too.
Was my support helpful?
Not bad. Good work.
So how was it? How'd you like my support?
Impressive skill. I'll keep counting on you.
Not bad skills. Where'd you learn that?
You're finally getting it, this passion thing.
Thank goodness you're safe. I was a little worried.
Keeping up with me, huh. Quite skilled.
Together, anything's a breeze!
Well, the mission's over. Shall we relax?
Count on you next time, too.
You're teaming with me next time, too. Nobody else satisfies me.
Looking forward to the next sortie, too!
Hey, I'm counting on you next mission, too.
Not bad at all, you.
Well, there's no way we'd lose.
Work's done. Let's go grab a drink.
Be my partner from now on. No, my soul buddy!
I feel any mission will be fine with you.
I don't mind continuing as your partner.
I'm completely smitten with you.
Let's rest up for the next one.
It's nice to have someone watch your back.
Hmph, looks like you've already surpassed me.
I'll always welcome sorties with you!
Come on, join me for a drink. I'll pour you something special.
I was nervous. With you I get so nervous.
I think our teamwork got sharper.
Teaming with you is too easy. That's the problem.
Looks like the mission ended safely. Want a drink in my room?
Let's have some tea and relax after this.
Can you eat pineapple? Come by my place.
rows.notes: Pine read as pineapple; might be pai (pie).

rows.en: Steak is waiting for us! On you, of course!
Sortieing with you... This looks like a struggle.
I'll do my own thing.
Not really in the mood to team up with a woman.
Um, I'm sortieing with you?
Sortieing next to a little girl, huh.
Just don't get in my way. That's all.
Um, it'd help if you stayed back.
Don't make me work for it.
Heads up. I won't back you up just because you're a woman.
Yes, if it's an order, I have no choice.
I can handle this much alone.
Wow... With you? This'll be rough.
Um, please don't move on your own.
Why don't you go home, miss?
Tch, you probably can't feel my passion.
Um, well, never mind!
Don't do anything unnecessary.
Is this the worst or what?
rows.notes: Unclear whether she means the partner or the situation.

rows.en: Okay! Let's go!
Let's go! Stay sharp!
Watch out you don't get burned by my passion.
Here we go!
Let's go, girl!
All right! Let's fire it up!
Here we go!
Mission start. Let's go.
Spirit! Spirit! Yeah!
rows.notes: Heard 'kiyagi da kiyagi'; probably 'kiai da kiai' (fighting spirit).

rows.en: This mission will be okay, right?
Follow me.
Heh heh heh, think you can keep up with me?
Let's finish this quickly.
Well then, let's get to it.
Let's go! Follow me!
Let's stay calm!
Don't let up for a second!
Stay alert! The mission's starting!
Let's show our full strength!
Burn my gallant form into your eyes.
You'll feel it, my passion.
I think this mission will be fine with you.
The party's starting. Save the main course.
rows.notes: Unclear whether she means leave some enemies for her or for later.
